build_Pointnet2Backbone: build a Pointnet2Backbone network for point cloud feature learning with configurable input feature dimensions
run_Pointnet2Backbone_forward: run a forward pass of the Pointnet2Backbone on a point cloud tensor to extract multi-scale features
test_Pointnet2Backbone: test the Pointnet2Backbone module by running a random point cloud tensor through the network
review_Pointnet2Backbone_forward: review the Pointnet2Backbone forward pass that performs four set abstraction layers and two feature upsampling layers
